title: Effectiveness of MIRT on Hand and Finger Dexterity in PD Patients
brief_summary: Aims of the study are (1) to evaluate the effectiveness of a specific OT treatment aimed to enhance finger and hand dexterity and (2) its impact on daily living autonomy of PD patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of Parkinson's Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* other neurological disease
* psychosis
* auditive or visual deficit
